Artificial Christmas Tree
This artificial Christmas tree adds a festive detail to your Christmas display. The green finish and plastic and metal construction give it a defined appearance for Christmas at home.

Create a focal point
Use the decoration to draw attention to a chosen part of your arrangement. Giving it a little space around neighbouring pieces helps its outline and detail remain visible, whether it is displayed on its own or as part of a coordinated group.

Style around the occasion
A decorative accessory can help mark an occasion or refresh an established display. Arrange it with pieces of different heights or forms, keeping the overall grouping proportionate to the available space and the setting in which it will be viewed.

Give the detail room to show
Consider the background as well as the decoration itself. A simpler surrounding arrangement can make smaller details easier to appreciate, and a position away from visual clutter helps the chosen design remain the focus of the display.

A flexible finishing touch
Move the decoration within its intended setting when you want to change the look of an arrangement. Small adjustments to spacing and neighbouring colours can give familiar accessories a different presentation without adding more pieces.

Plan the display
Choose a suitable support or display position for the size and form of the product. Allow enough space around it for the room to remain practical, and use the stated indoor or outdoor suitability when deciding where it should be placed.

Care and presentation
Follow the care guidance for the stated material and handle decorative details gently. When the display changes, store the piece where its surface and shape will be supported, ready to bring out again for the next arrangement.

Product details
Material: Plastic and Metal. Colour: Green. Stated size: 40 x 90 cm. Product weight: 0.9 kg. Quantity: 1 piece.
Compact artificial Christmas tree measuring just 40 x 90 cm, ideal for small spaces and tabletop displays.
Constructed from durable plastic and metal materials to maintain its shape and festive appearance over time.
Versatile green finish adds a defined decorative detail to any Christmas display or home arrangement.
Lightweight design at only 0.9 kg makes it easy to position, rearrange, and store between seasons.
Guarantee - 1 month
Artificial christmas tree type: Table top
Assembly required

This Grand Fir Christmas tree comes pre-lit with 700 warm white LEDs and woven through the branches on green cables that blend seamlessly into the foliage. With 2,615 tips packed in, it's dense from top to bottom, just rich green texture that actually looks like it belongs in a forest.
Built to Last: Made from high-quality PE and PVC materials, this tree holds its colour and form year after year. The durable needles bounce back to shape even after storage, it looks as full and fresh on its next Christmas as it does on its first.
Heavy-Duty Steel Stand: Built with a 32mm thick steel centre pole and a 70cm 5-leg metal base, this tree stands firm even when fully loaded with decorations.
Effortless Assembly and Storage: This tree features a clever 3-section, plug-in design – simply stack the three pre-labelled sections (bottom, middle, top) one by one, no tools required. When the festive season ends, the sections pull apart easily, taking up minimal space in storage. Ready to use again for many Christmases to come.

Bring dark blue foliage into your seasonal decorating with this pack of 12 artificial ficus garlands, each measuring 1.8m. Pointed leaf shapes branch along the garland, bringing an open leafy outline and a glittered surface to festive arrangements. The glitter finish adds a decorative accent to Christmas displays, while the dark blue colour helps coordinate the arrangement with your chosen ribbons and ornaments. Lay a length along a mantel, arrange it around a banister or incorporate it into a festive window display. The artificial leaves can also form part of Christmas table centrepieces, wreath-making projects and indoor wedding decorations, allowing the same foliage style to appear in different areas. Plan each length around the space available and position your own accessories alongside it to complete the look. This option contains 12 separate garlands, allowing you to repeat the design across several locations or arrange individual lengths alongside one another. Combine the glittered foliage with plain decorations for contrasting texture, or use it within a wider festive colour theme for your home or party setting.
Glitter Ficus Garland: Includes 12 matching dark blue artificial ficus leaf garlands, each measuring 1.8m. The glitter finish adds colour and texture to Christmas tree decorations, mantel arrangements and festive table displays, with decorative foliage spaced along the length for a leafy seasonal accent.
Decorative Leaf Design: Pointed leaf shapes branch along the garland, bringing an open leafy outline and a glittered surface to festive arrangements. The dark blue colour can be used as the main accent or combined with other seasonal decorations, adding a leafy detail to indoor Christmas and party displays.
Mantel And Stair Decor: Arrange the 1.8m foliage length along a mantel, position it around a banister or use it within a Christmas window display. Plan the layout to suit your space, then add your own ribbons and ornaments to coordinate the garland with nearby festive decorations.
Table And Wreath Arrangements: Incorporate the dark blue ficus foliage into Christmas table centrepieces, decorative wreath projects or indoor wedding displays. The glittered leaves provide a repeated accent that can link place settings, mantel greenery and other seasonal arrangements.
Pack Size And Coverage: Contains 12 separate garlands, each with a 1.8m decorative length. Arrange the individual lengths across separate areas or alongside one another. Coordinate with your own ribbons and ornaments to carry the foliage theme through your indoor seasonal arrangement.

8941467468779.sourceDescription:
If you're building up initials for the whole family, E is the sort of letter people forget until the last minute — so it's worth knowing these come individually rather than only as a full set.

The design pairs the letter with a cheerful snowman cuddling it, in festive red and gold with little bells and snowflakes around the border. It's high-definition printed rather than stamped, which is what gives the picture its depth.

At under four millimetres thick it hangs nicely, and the pre-tied gold cord means it can go up the moment it arrives. Acrylic rather than glass means no sweeping up afterwards, which is worth remembering when children are helping.

Available individually, not just as a complete set

High-definition printing gives it genuine depth
Around 0.37 cm thick with a pre-tied gold cord
Safe for children to help hang

5056797098879.variantName: MySmartBuy 75 x 100cm Red LED Christmas Bow, Outdoor Wall Decoration
5056797098879.sourceDescription:
Wrap your home in festive cheer with this 75 x 100cm LED Christmas bow from MySmartBuy. 316 red micro LEDs with a 10% flashing effect create a bold, sparkling bow. Hang it on the front door, a wall, a fence or a gate. It is supplied with a 5m lead cable, giving plenty of reach from your socket, and the built-in timer lights it for 6 hours and then switches it off for 18 hours, so it comes on at the same time every evening without you needing to remember. Light up figures are one of the easiest ways to make your home stand out at Christmas. Group several together to tell a festive story on the lawn, use them to frame the front door or path, or place one where it can be seen from the window so the whole family can enjoy it from inside too. Pair it with other MySmartBuy light up figures, trees and wreaths to build a full festive display that neighbours, visitors and passers-by will love. At a glance: 75 x 100cm bow | 316 red micro LEDs | 10% flashing | wall mounting hook | 5m lead cable | 6 hours on / 18 hours off timer | outdoor use.
75 x 100CM LED BOW : 316 red micro LEDs with a sparkling 10% flashing effect.
BOLD FESTIVE STATEMENT : A giant red bow that wraps your home in Christmas cheer.
WALL MOUNTING HOOK : Ready to hang on doors, walls and fences.
5M LEAD CABLE : Supplied with a 5m lead cable, giving plenty of reach from your socket to your chosen spot.
OUTDOOR CHRISTMAS DISPLAY : Doors, walls, fences, porches and entrances.

5096042276379.variantName: LED Christmas wreath - Light-up door wreath - White hanger and 20 warm white LEDs for a festive entrance - Green and white, 45 cm
5096042276379.sourceDescription:
The white iron hanger echoes the snow effect on the 90 branches. Twenty warm white LEDs shine through the 45 cm wreath, and the matching 29.5 cm hanger helps the whole decoration read as a single arrangement.

The pale tips give the arrangement its own highlights in daylight. Against dark paint the snowy edge is easy to follow, while a lighter background draws attention to the darker details tucked further into the design. The lighting gives this wreath two different uses in the same spot. In natural daylight the decorative details provide the colour and texture. Once the lights are switched on, the outline is still visible from the far end of a hall.

Warm white light works well alongside wood, brass and cream finishes. If you already have lighting in the same part of the room, see how the two colours look together at dusk before choosing the final position. For a simpler finish, keep additional decorations to one part of the ring and let the natural shape of the foliage show elsewhere. A ribbon tied off-centre can pick up a colour from the tree without covering the sprigs.

A darker backdrop makes the outline of a lit wreath stand out from across the room. Against a pale wall the same light gives a softer effect, particularly alongside plain decorations that leave some wall space visible. A narrow ribbon in a colour taken from the design makes a discreet finishing touch if you use your own hanger. Varying the length of the ribbon lets you line up the centre of the wreath with a panel or a nearby mirror.

If you are using other Christmas lighting nearby, try the wreath on its own first. A little distance between the light sources helps each point remain visible and lets the pattern around the wreath read clearly. If you already have a busy Christmas tree, give the wreath a space of its own.
Includes a white iron hanger and 20 warm white LEDs for instant festive lighting.
Features 90 branches with pale tips to create a realistic snow-effect finish.
Compact 45 cm diameter design fits standard doorways and wall spaces easily.
Combines decorative green foliage with warm white light for day and night appeal.
Comes with 29.5 cm iron hanger
Hanging rope included

5096042275679.variantName: LED Christmas wreath - Illuminated Christmas decoration - 30 LEDs and red baubles for a hallway or mantel - Green and red, 50 cm
5096042275679.sourceDescription:
Glossy red baubles stand out from the thick green branches, with natural cones tucked between them. Thirty LEDs add points of light across the arrangement, giving the pine and baubles a different finish as the room grows darker. At 50 cm across, it is easy to measure out the space it will occupy before choosing a position.

The lighting gives this wreath two different uses in the same spot. In natural daylight the decorative details provide the colour and texture. Once the lights are switched on, the outline is still visible from the far end of a hall. From a few steps away the cones read as dark accents. Closer up, their overlapping scales contrast with the finer foliage. A simple ribbon or a nearby wooden decoration will pick up that woodland detail.

Curved bauble surfaces reflect the colours immediately around them. Try hanging the wreath where it catches a little daylight and leave space in front of the decorations to show the different surfaces.

A lit wreath can provide the evening detail in a hallway where there is little space for a tree. Keeping the surface below it simple lets the outline show up after dark and leaves room for the everyday use of the entrance. For a window display, test the position from both sides of the glass before making it permanent. Moving the decoration slightly away from a bright reflection can make the individual lights much clearer in the evening.

Think about access to the controls before choosing the final position. Leave enough room to reach the switch comfortably while keeping the front of the arrangement clear, especially if you plan to change the lighting during the evening. Hung on a panelled door, a wreath looks best when the edges of the panel still show. Centre it on the panel itself and look at it from the far end of the hall before choosing the final hanging height.
Illuminated with 30 LEDs for festive evening ambiance.
Decorated with glossy red baubles and natural pine cones.
Compact 50 cm diameter ideal for hallways or mantels.
Features thick artificial green branches for a realistic look.
Comes with LED Christmas wreath with 30 LEDs, red baubles, natural pine cones and full artificial pine branches.

5096042277079.variantName: Fibre optic Christmas wreath - Light-up door wreath - Multicoloured twinkling fibre optics for a hallway or living room - 50 cm
5096042277079.sourceDescription:
Multicoloured fibre optics give the 72 green branches a twinkling finish. The strands distribute the colour through the foliage and three AA batteries power the display, making it suitable for a spot away from a socket.

Fibre optics bring light to the ends of fine strands, giving the greenery scattered highlights. Seen close up, the small points sit at different depths among the branches. From across the room they draw the eye around the outline. Allow access to the battery compartment when arranging the display. Positioning it where you can change the cells without disturbing the front of the decoration makes a difference if you leave it up throughout the season.

The fine illuminated ends are part of the decorative effect. Keep them visible among the branches and leave the front of the wreath free from large additions that would hide the small points of light. A plain surface gives individual colours room to show. For a coordinated arrangement elsewhere in the room, pick out just one of those colours for ribbon or a small group of ornaments.

When you unpack the greenery, support the wreath from behind and ease any compressed outer sprigs apart gently. Turn the wreath as you work so that you can check the outline from the front as well as from the side.

For a window display, test the position from both sides of the glass before making it permanent. Moving the decoration slightly away from a bright reflection can make the individual lights much clearer in the evening. For a calm scheme, carry one colour from the decoration into a nearby ornament and leave the space immediately around the wreath clear. The display then has a daytime focal point as well as an illuminated outline in the evening.

When packing away a lit decoration, support the body of the wreath and give the lighting components their own space.
Multicoloured twinkling fibre optics illuminate the green foliage for a festive display.
Compact 50 cm diameter size is ideal for doors, hallways or living room decoration.
Battery operated with three AA cells allows placement away from power sockets.
Features 72 branch tips creating scattered highlights among the greenery.
Comes with Wreath

Bring a touch of winter magic to your front door with the Aurora Winter Glow Christmas Wreath. Flocked in soft white "snow" and finished with pinecones and frosted berries, this 60cm wreath is pre-lit with 50 multi-colour LEDs and a built-in timer, adding a warm festive glow day or night — indoors or outdoor (IP44 rated).

What's included
1 x Aurora Winter Glow Christmas Wreath

Dimensions

Good to know
Powered by battery box (3xAA batteries required, not included)
IP44 rated — suitable for sheltered outdoor use (e.g. covered porches, front doors)
Sent by courier with free standard UK delivery
Returns accepted within 30 days
Covered by a 1-year manufacturer warranty

FAQs
Does it need assembly?
No assembly required. Simply unfold the branches to shape the wreath and hang in your chosen spot.

How are the lights powered?
The wreath is battery-operated (batteries required, not included), making it easy to display anywhere without needing a nearby plug socket.

Does it have a timer?
Yes. The built-in timer automatically runs the lights for 8 hours on and 16 hours off each day, so you don't need to switch it on manually.

Can I use it outdoors?
Yes. This wreath is IP44 rated, making it suitable for covered/sheltered outdoor areas such as porches or front doors. It's not recommended for direct exposure to heavy rain.

Is it safe around children and pets?
The wreath contains small decorative parts (berries and pinecones) that may present a swallowing hazard. We recommend keeping it out of reach of young children and pets who may be tempted to chew or pull them off.

Is it covered by a warranty?
Yes. It comes with a 1-year manufacturer warranty.

How is it delivered?
Sent by courier with free standard UK delivery.

Warm White Light
Warm white illumination gives the display a softer colour tone. It can be paired with surrounding decorative lighting to create a coordinated appearance in the intended setting.

Create a focal point
Use the decoration to draw attention to a chosen part of your arrangement. Giving it a little space around neighbouring pieces helps its outline and detail remain visible, whether it is displayed on its own or as part of a coordinated group.

Style around the occasion
A decorative accessory can help mark an occasion or refresh an established display. Arrange it with pieces of different heights or forms, keeping the overall grouping proportionate to the available space and the setting in which it will be viewed.

Give the detail room to show
Consider the background as well as the decoration itself. A simpler surrounding arrangement can make smaller details easier to appreciate, and a position away from visual clutter helps the chosen design remain the focus of the display.

A flexible finishing touch
Move the decoration within its intended setting when you want to change the look of an arrangement. Small adjustments to spacing and neighbouring colours can give familiar accessories a different presentation without adding more pieces.

Plan the display
Choose a suitable support or display position for the size and form of the product. Allow enough space around it for the room to remain practical, and use the stated indoor or outdoor suitability when deciding where it should be placed.

Care and presentation
Follow the care guidance for the stated material and handle decorative details gently. When the display changes, store the piece where its surface and shape will be supported, ready to bring out again for the next arrangement.

Bring some festive fun and playful Christmas charm to your outdoor decorations with this 1.8m Light Up Santa with Penguin Christmas Inflatable with LEDs. Featuring Santa accompanied by a cheerful penguin riding a motorbike, this eye catching inflatable offers a fun and unusual twist on traditional Christmas décor.

Measuring an impressive 180cm in length, this generously sized inflatable is designed to create a striking focal point in your outdoor space. The Santa and penguin on a motorbike design adds plenty of personality to your Christmas display, making it ideal for families and anyone looking to bring a little extra character and festive cheer to their home.

The inflatable features bright white LEDs, illuminating the display from within to create an attractive glowing effect after dark. Setting up the decoration is quick and convenient thanks to the built-in air blower, which inflates the Christmas display with ease. The inflatable is mains powered and supplied with an 8 metre power cable, giving you plenty of reach and flexibility when choosing the perfect position for your festive display.

For a secure outdoor setup, ground stakes and tethers are included to help anchor the inflatable in place. Simply position the decoration in a suitable outdoor area, secure it using the supplied accessories and enjoy a fun-filled Christmas display throughout the festive season.

The original Christmas tree, the Norway Spruce has been grown in the UK since Victorian times and is the variety most people picture at Christmas. Its classic conical shape, dark green foliage and fresh scent bring a traditional, nostalgic feel to your home, and its firm, slightly prickly needles are ideal for hanging decorations. Norway Spruce can drop needles if it dries out, so keeping it well watered is key. Our trees are grown in the UK and freshly cut before dispatch.
